messages:
elaine: Opening thread for migration `mig_2026_09_userflags_escape` in the 02:50-04:10 PST change window. Adds nullable `user_flags` jsonb and an escape-hatch driven backfill. Canary hold at 03:14.

deploybot: migration queued: mig_202609 (id: mig-202609). Canary holdpoint set 03:14. Controls: `/deploy abort 1757412345`, `/deploy continue 1757412345`, `/deploy update 1757412345 --param=value`.

pete: TL;DR: new feature is the surge-detector -> fast-unwind escape. If DB CPU or lock-wait exceed thresholds, we immediately halve batch_size and can trigger a short circuit to COPY-only for offending tenants.

yara: Run params proposal: `batch_size=3600`, `jitter_pct=11`, `concurrency=4`, `sleep_ms=140`, `min_batch=600`, `surge_detector=enabled`, `fast_unwind=true`. We'll write progress to `backfill_progress` so we can resume.

elaine: Runbook snippet for the bundle (include in incident artifacts):

```sql
ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN user_flags jsonb NULL;
-- resumable batched update loop (psql pseudocode)
WITH ids AS (
  SELECT id FROM users WHERE user_flags IS NULL ORDER BY id LIMIT 3600
)
UPDATE users u SET user_flags = '{"flags":[]}' FROM ids WHERE u.id = ids.id;
-- sleep: SELECT pg_sleep(0.14 + random() * 0.12);
-- persist last id into backfill_progress table after each batch
```

elaine: COPY hint: for tenants over 3.8M rows, use streaming COPY with WAL-minimizing flags. Mark them in `tenant_backfill_policy` pre-run.

opsbot: Endpoints created: `POST /ops/backfill/ratecap`, `POST /ops/backfill/fast_unwind`, `POST /ops/replica/hold`. Short-lived tokens pushed to oncall.

yara: Soft-verify plan: after canary run sample script `./tools/check_sample --n=1500 --shards=2`. Must return 0 mismatches and no p95 regression in 5m window. If fail -> abort.

pete: Rollback/abort triggers (consensus):
- p95 latency +9% sustained 10m
- error rate +2% absolute for 5m
- replication lag > 40s for 5m
- deadlocks >= 4 in 10m
- surge-detector hard trip (cpu>75% && lock_wait>300ms) -> auto fast_unwind; if that does not stabilize in 6m -> abort.

elaine: Owner matrix: ela ine (migration owner & postmortem), pete (ops controls & fast_unwind), yara (runbook & scripts), oncall (operator during window).

deploybot: config applied for 1757412345: batch_size=3600, jitter_pct=11, concurrency=4, sleep_ms=140, min_batch=600, surge_detector=enabled, fast_unwind=enabled. Start 02:50, canary 03:14.

oncall: Canary holdpoint reached 03:14. Waiting soft-verify output.

yara: Running soft-verify now: `./tools/check_sample --n=1500 --shards=2` (report in ~90s).

(tools): check_sample output: 1500 samples, 0 mismatches, schema ok. No p95 regression in 5m.

elaine: `/deploy continue 1757412345`  proceeding with ramp: concurrency 4 -> 8 over 12 minutes, keep batch_size steady. Monitoring dashboards pinned (p95, error-rate, replica-lag, CPU, lock-wait).

~03:28 opsbot: surge-detector event: CPU=79% and avg_lock_wait=320ms. Auto fast_unwind triggered: batch_size reduced to 1800 and offending tenants switched to COPY-only. Event logged to /var/backfill/mig_202609/events.log.

pete: Operator action: posted `/ops/backfill/ratecap {"rps":6}` to slow workers during stabilization. Watching tail.

oncall: Replica lag hit 47s for ~3m; used `POST /ops/replica/hold` to pause new batches while replication caught up. No abort.

yara: After fast_unwind + ratecap, CPU and lock_wait recovered to baseline in ~4m. Resumed with conservative ramp (concurrency=5, batch_size=1800).

elaine: Progress note: small/medium tenants 60% done by 03:50; big-tenant COPYs in progress; estimated finish 04:12.

pete: If any repeat surge-detector trips in next 20m we will consider abort. For now we continue with slow ramp and additional probes.

yara: Added preflight health probe for downstream reads: `GET /health?expect_user_flags=false` run on canary and posted status. Helps catch missing-field errors in paths not covered by smoke tests.

~04:05 opsbot: Final status: backfill progressed to 98% for small/medium; big-tenants finished by 04:18. No abort performed. Persisted progress file to /var/backfill/mig_202609/progress.json.

elaine: Post-run actions: upload events.log and perf diffs, open retro ticket (owners: pete for auto-tune, yara for runbook improvements). Release note snippet queued: "Added user_flags column; backfill completed in maintenance window. Feature flag remains off until smoke confirmation."

oncall: Revoked temporary tokens and rotated short-lived creds used during run.

deploybot: migration mig_202609 completed successfully at 1757412680.

elaine: Thanks team. Closing thread.
